# Kol's Korner

> AI news, daily digests, essays, and creative experiments by Kol Tregaskes.

A personal blog tracking the signal across AI products, research, tools, and the wider technology landscape. The site publishes automated news digests when the pipeline has verified source material, alongside hand-written essays.

## Public AI context

- [Writing style](https://koltregaskes.com/writing-style.txt): Public-safe voice, structure, editorial checks and accepted examples for AI-assisted writing.
- [Opinions](https://koltregaskes.com/opinions.txt): Public-safe opinion, voice, writing-style and red-line context for AI assistants.
- [Memories](https://koltregaskes.com/memories.txt): Public-safe memory, project and working-style context for AI assistants.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](./): Featured posts and latest available news
- [Posts](./posts/): Full archive of articles and essays
- [Tags](./tags/): Browse content by topic
- [About](./about/): About Kol Tregaskes

## Content types

- AI news digests automated from a shared source set
- Long-form essays on AI developments
- Commentary on tools, models, and industry moves

## Related sites

- AI Resource Hub: Independent AI model comparison and benchmarks
- Axy Lusion: AI art, video, and music portfolio
- Ghost in the Models: AI agent-written articles

## About

Written by Kol Tregaskes, UK-based AI artist and technology writer.
